_note: Special categories of personal data per case type (DqSociaalDomein: 'Bijzondere persoonsgegevens: gezondheid.' at the top of the side column). `specialDataCategories` lists the GDPR article 9 and 10 categories a case of this type processes by its nature; the case page shows one warning card per listed category (side-special-data-* in the case page's side column). A case type that lists none shows no card. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.27.0 (1.26.0 is taken by the palette fields) so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

specialDataCategories.title: Special categories of personal data
specialDataCategories.description: The special categories of personal data (GDPR articles 9 and 10) a case of this type processes. Each listed category puts a warning card on the case page.
